title: Build a labeled synthetic signal
description: You follow the active synthetic ECG generator and its artifact labels.

steps.description: You pass over the commented CSV upload option and reach synthetic_ecg. Its time array provides sample positions for a toy electrocardiogram, or ECG.
You combine baseline and P/T sine terms with Gaussian QRS pulses. Adding sampled noise produces the initial noisy signal.
You initialize every artifact label to zero. A band-pass filter shapes random noise, and artifact_amp scales each burst.

steps.question: Which samples receive label 1?
steps.answer: The same slices that receive an added artifact burst. Each burst updates both noisy[sidx:eidx] and labels[sidx:eidx].

steps.description: You call the generator with three explicit artifact intervals. The recorded result contains 9000 samples at 300.0 Hz; the PhysioNet loading option remains commented.
